description: Front-matter shape for .vibe-prompt/remediate/pending/<finding-id>.diff staged fix files. Body is a unified diff; this schema validates only the YAML front-matter.

findingCategory.description: Top-level fix category. A = mechanical content drop-in. B = contradiction removal. C = sanitization defense. v0.6+ adds sub-category notation: `B-voice-frame` distinguishes voice-frame rewrites from banned-phrase removals (different confidence + routing). v0.7+ adds D-1/D-2/D-3 migration categories: D-1 = inline-to-registry, D-2 = typed-renderer, D-3 = model-consolidation.

migrationKind.description: v0.7+. Explicit migration-template identifier; mirrors findingCategory D-1/D-2/D-3.

consolidatedFindingIds.description: v0.7+. When this fix closes multiple findings (e.g., F10+F11 consolidation), the additional finding IDs beyond `findingId`.

voiceFrameRewriteRationale.description: v0.6+. Explains how the proposed rewrite aligns with the extracted global-directive voice rule. Populated when findingCategory is `B-voice-frame`.
